desc: 雾蓝三阶云絮场配白色羽绒与哑光卡纸台，突出面部防晒霜的轻薄空气感
leaf: 轻薄空气感面部防晒霜（软管装）
name: 雾蓝云絮羽感防晒软管款

shots.intent: 首屏用三阶雾蓝云场托住软管轮廓，以干净的立式剪影赢点击
一秒给出核心利益，用右侧三行留白卖点栏承接首屏承诺
shots.textZone: right column, three stacked label rails read from top downward

shots.intent: 放大厚重闷黏与城市微粒附着的不适感，引出轻薄诉求
用微距膜面的均匀与透薄证明肤感，不借助任何指数或刻度
把空气感与轻薄肤感转译成可看的羽绒场景证据，完成自我代入
同机位同光双栏对照铺展厚薄，让差异一眼可读
shots.textZone: one blank rounded chip at the foot of each panel

shots.intent: 以留白卡位与空按钮完成收口，不引入促销数字与角标
shots.textZone: lower third frost-white inset: one headline rail plus one empty button slot

style.backgroundSystem: three horizon-free haze strata of one cool family only: frost white #F7FBFE upper haze, cloud-blue #DCEAF3 mid field, deeper mist #BFD7EA base band; never a sky, never a scenery, never a stone ledge, plaster sweep, sand bed, ceramic board, louvered shadow stripe or tinted filter flag with a colour pool
style.direction: airy cool skincare commerce built on layered haze-blue fields and white down
style.iconSystem: none beyond thin-line leading rules and blank rounded chips in mist-blue #6E9BD6; no sun disc, ray burst, shield, clock, hourglass, umbrella, droplet, bubble or ball-and-stick molecule glyphs
style.lightingSystem: all-around diffused mist light with a soft fill from the upper left or upper right, weightless contact shadows, one satin highlight along the tube shoulder; no hard-edged shadow stripe, no cone beam, no burnt-in highlight
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent airy cool skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of frost white #F7FBFE, cloud-blue #DCEAF3, deeper mist #BFD7EA, mist-blue accent #6E9BD6 and deep petrol ink #1B3E56; three horizon-free haze strata stand in for any scenery or backdrop photograph; all-around diffused mist light with a soft upper fill, weightless contact shadows and one satin highlight along the tube shoulder; matte coated paperboard risers and sheets plus a frost-white down-filled cushion pad as the only surfaces; loose white goose-down plumes as the only prop; one modern geometric sans-serif family with thin-line leading rules and blank rounded chips, no icons and no numerals; stable tube stance and scale with the label face never occluded; no warm cast, no stone or plaster staging, no louvered shadow stripe, no sand or shell texture, no filter flag or tinted light pool, no sun-ray or shield graphics, no protection factors or measured figures, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting.
noDrift: no colour palette changes outside #F7FBFE, #DCEAF3, #BFD7EA, #6E9BD6 and #1B3E56
no warm cast and no beige, sand, gold, coral or amber tone entering any frame
no stone ledge, cotton cloth, plaster sweep, louvered shadow stripe, fine sand ridges, shells, ceramic tile, translucent filter flag or tinted light pool as staging
no sun, ray, shield, clock, hourglass, umbrella, droplet, bubble or molecule graphics, and no band-chart or spectrum-row diagram
no protection factors, durations, percentages, net-content figures, certificates, test reports or lab data rendered anywhere in the image
no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no numerals or circled numbers in the layout
style.presentationRules: the tube keeps one stance and one scale across every screen: standing on its flat crimped cap end for product views, laid with its cap beside it only in the closing flat lay; the label face is never occluded by down plumes or props
style.surfaceSystem: matte coated paperboard risers and sheets in cloud-blue #DCEAF3 and deeper mist #BFD7EA, plus a frost-white #F7FBFE down-filled cushion pad; loose white goose-down plumes are the only soft goods
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family; in-image Chinese only as short placeholder rails and chips set in deep petrol ink #1B3E56 with a mist-blue #6E9BD6 leading rule; no script, no handwriting, no retro or cartoon lettering, no numerals anywhere
